model_availability.limitation: Preferred exact models were unavailable; nearby profiles lacked workspace tools for this round.

findings.finding: CRITICAL-BOUND stopped before the maximal endpoint and was tautologically too weak.
findings.repair: Quantified the uniform L3 bound on the complete finite maximal interval.

findings.finding: The Clay-A chain omitted local classical existence and the smooth energy identity.
findings.repair: Added LOCAL-CLASSICAL and SMOOTH-ENERGY and strengthened GLOBAL-CONTINUATION.

findings.finding: The exact triad test was periodic but had been discussed as a whole-space refutation.
findings.repair: Scoped the claim and route to the three-torus.

findings.finding: The cascade artifact refuted only a shell-time diagonal inference, not a full exact cascade.
findings.repair: Narrowed the refuted claim and left exact synchronized cascade construction blocked.

findings.finding: ENERGY-CLASS used a weak-solution label broader than Leray-Hopf.
findings.repair: Named the exact Leray-Hopf existence and energy class.

findings.finding: Type-I-to-self-similar and all-critical-space compactness claims lacked counterexamples.
findings.repair: Downgraded BUP-003 and BUP-006 from refuted to blocked.

findings.finding: The ESS summary omitted the uniform time quantifier.
findings.repair: Restored L-infinity-time L3-space through the putative endpoint.

findings.finding: The compact-orbit corollary omitted its orbit formula and scaling dependency.
findings.repair: Defined the all-time orbit and added NS-SCALING.

findings.finding: Scaling and interpolation claims had no complete proof artifacts.
findings.repair: Added docs/proofs/FOUNDATIONAL_DERIVATIONS.md with exact change-of-variable and interpolation calculations.

findings.finding: One flux direction, one periodic scaling range, and one computation-source locator were wrong.
findings.repair: Corrected influx terminology, required nonnegative integer torus scaling, and changed Proposition 5.4 to 5.5.

findings.finding: Settled claims could hide blocked dependencies.
findings.repair: Applied dependency checks to both proved and established claims with a regression test.

findings.finding: Evidence and proof-artifact strings did not need to resolve.
findings.repair: Added repository path and Markdown-anchor validation; proved artifacts must live under docs/proofs.

findings.finding: Malformed ledgers crashed and cycle paths duplicated their endpoint.
findings.repair: Made malformed input total, repaired cycle output, and added CLI regressions.

findings.finding: No target contract, review record, or external-certification gate prevented silent Clay-target promotion.
findings.repair: Added canonical A-D contracts, settled-target certification requirements, and durable gauntlet records.

findings.finding: Reject every status upgrade when evidence appears in the same session.
findings.reason: A legitimate proof necessarily adds evidence with an upgrade; structural checks, git review, fresh gauntlets, and external certification address the actual risk.
